entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Android] SafeAreaRegions.SoftInput does nothing with the default AdjustPan, and enabling Resize is app-wide (modals check the wrong window) #40269
  • [iOS] SafeAreaRegions.SoftInput: focused Entry ends up hidden, and ScrollRectToVisible is ignored for the whole edit #40268
  • [repo-status] Daily Repo Status — 2026-11-15 🌟 #40267
  • [aw] Daily Memory Leak Hunter is missing required data #40265

Closed

  • [repo-status] Daily repo status — 2026-11-14: cross-platform fixes and servicing progress #40244

PullRequests

Created

  • [net11] Recover lost Android emulator before UI test retry #40273
    platform/android, area-infrastructure
  • [Android] Read the soft input mode from the window that hosts the view #40272
    community ✨

Merged

  • [Shell] Make literal global route matching independent of registration order #40182
    community ✨, s/agent-gate-passed
  • [XAML] Don't instantiate markup in x:DataType other than x:Type or x:Null #40270
    community ✨
  • [iOS] Clear the keyboard scroll flag when SoftInput handles the keyboard #40271
    community ✨
  • [Android] Fix Label LineHeight adding extra space below the first line #40188
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-label
  • [Android] Don't show the keyboard when a read-only input is focused from code #40261
    platform/android, community ✨, area-keyboard
  • [Android] Keep SoftInput test geometry valid on small displays #40264

Updated

  • [net12] Add ScrollAnchorMode to keep the start or end of a CollectionView in view #40211
    do-not-merge, s/agent-review-in-progress
  • [Release candidate] 11.0.1xx SR2 #40116
  • [SourceGen] Fix xmlns prefix expansion and TypedBinding emission in C# expressions #40263
    community ✨
  • Move main to .NET 12 #40060
    s/agent-gate-failed
  • [CI] Add /review run-tests to run only affected UI and device tests #40253
  • [Windows] Restore retained wrapper state and shadow visibility on handler reconnect #40156
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Fix BoxView redraw after WidthRequest and HeightRequest changes on iOS and MacCatalyst #39974
    platform/macos, area-drawing, platform/ios, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [net12] Add Span.TextDecorationColor and TextDecorationThickness (underline / strikethrough color and thickness) #40260
    s/agent-gate-passed
